app.run: There is no app to start. This repository produces files: `make all BOARD=` runs the whole chain and writes everything to `build//`: the schematic PDF, ERC and DRC reports, board renders (`render-top.png`, `render-bottom.png`, `render-angle.png`), flat drawings under `plots/` (SVG), fabrication data under `fab/` and enclosure STEP/STL under `enclosure/`. The throwaway board takes about 15 seconds; the valve node takes about two minutes, so start it with run_in_background (`make all BOARD=valve-node > build/vn.log 2>&1; echo exit $?`) and end your turn until it reports back, instead of sleeping or polling the log. A rebuild gives every item in `boards//eda/.kicad_pcb` new UUIDs (docs/toolchain.md, weakness 10): if `git diff` of that file shows only `uuid` lines, nothing moved; restore it with `git checkout -- boards//eda/` and commit it only after an intended change. To show work, put the outputs on an HTML page for the owner: the renders as they are, the SVG plots directly in `` tags (no conversion needed), and the schematic PDF as PNGs from `pdftoppm -png -r 120 build//.pdf build//schematic` (pdftoppm is installed; ImageMagick and mutool are not), plus the report summaries. A board or enclosure is never shown by opening KiCad or a CAD program. `make help` lists one command per output; `docs/toolchain.md` explains the chain. Never upload to or order from JLCPCB.
